$comment: Pinned toolchain versions for the native build. Read by tools/optimize.sh and
AGENTS.md. Record a version here rather than in a script banner.
emscripten: what CI installs and what emscripten/build.sh is validated against.
3.1.51 still emits a separate *.worker.js for pthreads (see BUILD_NOTES).
binaryen: the OUT-OF-BAND wasm-opt used by tools/optimize.sh. It is deliberately
NOT emsdk 3.1.51's bundled wasm-opt: that one is what fails the link at -O2+
on this pthreads+SIMD+bigint module, which is why emscripten/build.sh pins the
link at -O1. optimize.sh refuses any wasm-opt whose reported version does not
match `binaryen.version`, so a stray emsdk binary on PATH cannot silently
Vendored to public/pyodide/ by scripts/fetch-pyodide.mjs (pnpm run vendor:pyodide)
and loaded same-origin by index.html + emscripten/pyodide_bootstrap.js. Nothing
reaches a CDN at runtime — see docs/adr/0001-wam2-host.md.
public/pyodide/ is gitignored; the fetch is a setup step, not a build step.
$packagesComment: Their transitive closure is resolved from the vendored pyodide-lock.json,
so this list stays the two names the bootstrap actually asks for.
